text: I'm so sorry for the essay, I've been up since 5 this morning and I think my brain's stopped working. I'm a foster carer and I've had a little girl with me, she's 3, for about a fortnight now. Since yesterday afternoon she's had a temperature, it was 38.5 when I checked about half an hour ago. Then this evening at bath time I noticed a pinky rash over her tummy and down her legs. I remembered the glass thing from a training course so I pressed a glass on it and it does go pale and fade, so I'm hoping that means it's not anything awful. The other thing, and I don't know if it's related at all, is she hasn't done a poo for three days now. She's grumpy about it, keeps saying her bum is cross and refusing to sit on the potty. I don't have much of her history yet and I can't get hold of her social worker at this hour, which is why I'm messaging you. I just want to do the right thing by her. Is the rash something I need to get looked at tonight, and is there anything I can do about the constipation side of things?
